title: Network Participation Agreements — Overpayment Dispute Filing, Suspension and Resolution
content:
A practice holding one of the **Network Participation Agreements** may dispute an overpayment no later than the dispute window after the overpayment notice date.

## Filing in time

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Clock starts | The date of the overpayment notice, as recorded on Cascade's overpayment ledger |
| Length | The agreement type's dispute window, counted in calendar days (30 days under every agreement type) |
| Comparison | The dispute must be received no later than the last day of the window. A dispute received on the last day is timely. |

**Boundary (hypothetical).** A notice is dated 2 May. The 30-day window ends on 1 June. A dispute received on 1 June is timely. One received on 2 June is not.

## How often, and what a filing does

- Each overpayment may be disputed as many times as the agreement type's dispute levels allow, which is once under every agreement type. Cascade's dispute records for that overpayment show whether a filing already exists.
- A filing suspends offsetting of that overpayment until it is resolved.
- The resolution due date is the filing date plus the agreement type's resolution period of 30 calendar days.

## Resolution

A resolution has one of three outcomes. It upholds the overpayment, reduces it, or withdraws it. The resolution records the upheld amount, which is the amount that stands.

| Outcome | Effect on the receivable | Offsetting |
|---|---|---|
| Upheld | No reduction | Offsetting of the upheld amount may resume on the day after the resolution |
| Reduced | The receivable is lowered by the difference between the open amount and the upheld amount, recorded as a reduction entry dated on the resolution date | Offsetting of the upheld amount may resume on the day after the resolution |
| Withdrawn | The receivable is lowered by the difference between the open amount and the upheld amount, recorded as a reduction entry dated on the resolution date | Nothing remains to offset when the upheld amount is zero |

**Hypothetical.** An overpayment with an open amount of 400.00 USD is disputed, and the dispute is resolved on 10 July reducing it to an upheld amount of 250.00 USD. A reduction of 150.00 USD is recorded on 10 July. Offsetting of the remaining 250.00 USD may resume from 11 July.
